name: Jura Tempest Federation
summary: A monster-led nation founded by Rimuru Tempest, built on coexistence, strength, and innovation.

items.label: System:
items.text: Democratic Federation with Demon Lord oversight

items.label: Territory:
items.text: Great Jura Forest and surrounding regions
Create a world where monsters and humans coexist peacefully
Establish fair trade relationships with all nations
Protect all citizens regardless of race or origin
Maintain balance between development and nature

items.label: Tempest Wolves:
items.text: Dire wolf pack led by Ranga
Foundation after Goblin Village naming ceremony
Orc Lord crisis and territorial expansion
Falmuth War and Rimuru's awakening as True Demon Lord

name: Armed Nation of Dwargon
summary: A powerful dwarf kingdom known for superior craftsmanship, engineering, and military technology.

name: Kingdom of Ingrassia
summary: The strongest human nation with central location, wealth, and political influence.

name: Holy Empire Ruberios
summary: A theocratic empire secretly ruled by Demon Lord Luminous Valentine through her proxy, Holy Emperor Louis Valentine.

items.text: Balance Demon Lord and human interests

name: Eastern Empire
summary: The Nasca Namrium Ulmeria United Eastern Empire, the world's largest military superpower with over 2.1 million personnel before Tempest's emergence.

name: Kingdom of Blumund
summary: A small nation bordering Jura Forest, known for information trading and early alliance with Tempest.

name: Animal Kingdom Eurazania
summary: A beastman kingdom ruled by Demon Lord Carrion, known for advanced agriculture but limited technology.

name: Kingdom of Farmenas
summary: Successor state to the fallen Kingdom of Falmuth, established after Tempest's intervention.

name: Octagram (Demon Lords)
summary: The ruling council of eight Demon Lords that maintains global balance and oversees continental politics.

items.text: Maintain balance between human and monster nations
Regulate the actions of other Demon Lords

items.label: Clayman Incident:
items.text: Trial and execution of rogue member

name: Free Guild
summary: International adventurer's guild with headquarters in Ingrassia, managing quests and adventurer rankings.

name: Four Nations Trade Alliance
summary: Commercial alliance between Tempest, Blumund, Farmenas, and Dwargon for economic cooperation.

name: Western Holy Church
summary: Religious military organization based in Ruberios, violently opposed to monster nations and Demon Lords.

name: Cerberus
summary: Secret criminal organization based in the Eastern Empire, led by Yuuki Kagurazaka, handling both legal and illegal operations.

name: Kingdom of Falmuth (Fallen)
summary: Former trading kingdom that was dissolved after launching a failed war against Tempest to maintain trade monopoly.

name: Goblin Tribes
summary: The original inhabitants of Jura Forest who became the foundation of Tempest Federation.

name: Fanged Wolf Clan
summary: Powerful wolf monsters led by Ranga, serving as Tempest's elite cavalry and scouts.

items.text: Serve as Rimuru's personal mount and guard
Submission to Rimuru after Veldora's aura

name: Lizardmen Tribes
summary: Marsh-dwelling reptilian humanoids led by Gabiru, known for their adaptability and loyalty.
